title: Customer Holdings Clause: Number of Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards per Customer
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold any number of Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards of any type at the same time, each card being its own record with its own balance. There is no limit on the number of cards per customer.

## The clause in parts

| Question | Answer under the clause |
|---|---|
| Is there a most-cards-per-customer figure? | No; the number of cards a customer may hold has no limit. |
| May the cards be of different types? | Yes; any type, in any mix. |
| May the cards be of the same type? | Yes; any number of the same type. |
| How are the balances kept? | Each card is a separate record and carries its own balance. |

## Illustration (hypothetical holdings)

A customer who holds two Northgate Gift Cards, one Northgate Merchandise Return Card and one Northgate Reloadable Gift Card holds four cards, each with its own card record and its own balance; four balances are kept, one per card. Issuing a fifth card of any type to the same customer is consistent with the clause.
